serialization_contract.identity: protocol_sha256 is mandatory; metadata is implementation-owned.
serialization_contract.candidates: candidate_sets contains U_H, C_E and A_E as arrays of relations, each relation an array of concrete [source,target] pairs. Invalid input has null candidate_sets and counts.
serialization_contract.materials: material.associations retains concrete association pairs, every decision, retained/waived intentions, conjuncts, all accepting witnesses and full 27-row rejection certificates; outcomes retain decision identity.
serialization_contract.observables: observable_classes partitions full extensional ACCEPT maps and REJECT, retaining association/decision members; null for undefined query or unsupported policy.
serialization_contract.comparison: Compare exact emitted result fields extensionally. Source/target orientation and provenance snapshot ordering are significant. Duplicate candidates, outcomes, witnesses, decisions and classes fail.
serialization_contract.work_independence: Work counters are optional and ignored by comparison. C11 constructs six distinct-destination triples and direct material outcomes; it must not copy reference work counts.
